title: Early Feasibility Study of the Neovasc Tiara™ Mitral Valve System
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and initial performance of the Neovasc Tiara Mitral Transcatheter Heart Valve with the Tiara Transapical Delivery System.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe symptomatic mitral regurgitation (Stage D)
* High surgical risk for open mitral valve surgery
* Subject meets the anatomical eligibility criteria for available size(s)
* NYHA Class III or IV heart failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* DMR deemed by the heart team to be operable.
* Prohibitive risk, deemed too frail or listed for cardiac transplant.
* Unsuitable cardiac structure
